newsitem.title: FINLAND: SAUNATEC SEES BETTER FULL-YEAR 96 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: SAUNATEC SEES BETTER FULL-YEAR 96 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish sauna equipment maker Oy Saunatec Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its full-year 1996 earnings to improve on 1995.
"The earnings of this year are expected to be better than last year," Saunatec said in a statement with its January-August results.
Saunatec's 1995 profit after financial items was 12.6 million markka.
Saunatec earlier released its January-August report, which showed a 5.6 million markka profit after financial items, up from 3.7 million in the first eight months of 1995.
